verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents auto attendants, ring groups and greeting and announcement options. However, nothing in the evidence describes configuring business hours, closed-hours routing, or holiday schedules per number. Auto attendant menus and ring-group routing are related call-routing features, not the business-hours capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
